title: Generate quantum dot structures
action: Generate atomic coordinates for the three stoichiometric CdSe quantum dots (Cd₁₇Se₁₇, Cd₂₆Se₂₆, Cd₃₈Se₃₈) as spherical fragments of the wurtzite crystal. Ensure no surface atom has three dangling bonds and fix all atomic positions to bulk-like coordinates.
description: Input structures for the cluster calculations.

title: Run ground-state LDA DFT calculations
action: For each quantum dot structure, perform a spin-unpolarized Kohn-Sham DFT calculation using LDA (Ceperley–Alder), Troullier–Martins pseudopotentials, a higher-order finite-difference real-space grid with 0.7 a.u. spacing, a spherical domain with the outermost atom at least 14 a.u. from the boundary, and include unoccupied states exceeding twice the number of occupied states. Obtain Kohn–Sham eigenvalues, wavefunctions, and occupation numbers.
description: Ground-state calculation required to construct the TDLDA matrices.

title: Compute TDLDA optical gaps
action: Using the Kohn–Sham states from the ground-state calculation, construct the TDLDA coupling matrix K and the Q matrix, solve the eigenvalue equation Q F_n = Ω_n² F_n to obtain excitation energies and oscillator strengths. Broaden the transitions with a Gaussian of 0.1 eV FWHM to obtain the absorption spectrum. Extract the optical gap for each dot using the 2% cumulative oscillator strength rule (Eq. 3 of the paper). Write the three gap values (in eV) to optical_gaps.json.
description: Final optical gaps for Cd₁₇Se₁₇, Cd₂₆Se₂₆, and Cd₃₈Se₃₈ computed via TDLDA and the 2% rule.
output_schema: A JSON object with keys "Cd17Se17", "Cd26Se26", "Cd38Se38" mapping to float values in eV.
